__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus data source with the Tyk Dashboard metrics

title: Tyk Dashboard
description: Tyk Dashboard component (the control plane management service, not this Grafana page): dependencies, connected gateways, certificates, license, control API, change propagation and runtime.

panels.title: Environment
panels.description: Deployment environment this Tyk Dashboard runs in. Metric: tyk.dashboard.build.info

panels.title: Control plane
panels.description: Control plane ID this Tyk Dashboard belongs to. Metric: tyk.dashboard.build.info

panels.title: Tyk Dashboard version
panels.description: Tyk Dashboard version running on the instances. Metric: tyk.dashboard.build.info

panels.title: Instances
panels.description: Tyk Dashboard instances currently reporting. Metric: tyk.dashboard.build.info

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the most recently started Tyk Dashboard instance came up. Metric: process.uptime

panels.title: Main datastore
panels.description: Stores APIs, policies, users and organisations. Shows whether it answered Tyk Dashboard's latest ping, worst result across instances. Metric: tyk.dashboard.health

panels.title: Analytics datastore
panels.description: Stores aggregated API analytics shown in the Tyk Dashboard charts. Shows whether it answered Tyk Dashboard's latest ping, worst result across instances. Metric: tyk.dashboard.health

panels.title: Logs datastore
panels.description: Stores the per request logs shown in the log browser. Shows whether it answered Tyk Dashboard's latest ping, worst result across instances. Metric: tyk.dashboard.health

panels.title: Uptime test datastore
panels.description: Stores uptime test results. Shows whether it answered Tyk Dashboard's latest ping, worst result across instances. Metric: tyk.dashboard.health

panels.title: Redis
panels.description: Holds temporary data such as sessions, cache and messages sent to gateways. Shows whether it answered Tyk Dashboard's latest ping, worst result across instances. Metric: tyk.dashboard.health

panels.title: Connected gateways
panels.description: Gateways that pinged Tyk Dashboard in the last 30 seconds. Metric: tyk.dashboard.gateways.connected

panels.title: Late heartbeats
panels.description: Connected gateways whose last ping was 10 to 30 seconds ago. After 30 seconds they drop out of the count. Metric: tyk.dashboard.gateways.heartbeat_timestamp

targets.expr: label_replace((count((time() - max by (node_id) (tyk_dashboard_gateways_heartbeat_timestamp_seconds{service_name="tyk-dashboard",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"})) >= 10) or on() (0 * count(tyk_dashboard_gateways_heartbeat_timestamp_seconds{service_name="tyk-dashboard",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}))) == 0, "state", "✓ All under 10s ago", "", "") or label_replace((count((time() - max by (node_id) (tyk_dashboard_gateways_heartbeat_timestamp_seconds{service_name="tyk-dashboard",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"})) >= 10) or on() (0 * count(tyk_dashboard_gateways_heartbeat_timestamp_seconds{service_name="tyk-dashboard",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}))) > 0, "state", "⚠ 10 to 30s ago", "", "")
